blocked.name: Dongsi Santiao ancient tree hutong (东四三条)
blocked.reason: Not a single collectible point: 20 Grade-2 ancient Chinese Scholar Trees (Sophora japonica) line both sides of a 700-metre, 8-metre-wide hutong street, canopies meeting overhead. Genuinely free and public, and officially branded by the district government as the city's first 'ancient tree themed cultural hutong' (beijing.gov.cn, 2022-09-14), but it reads as an avenue rather than one tree or a compact ensemble with one obvious place to stand, which the rules block outright (the La Rambla precedent). Worth revisiting if a future pass finds one individually named standout tree within the street rather than the row as a whole.
